note: Machine-specific paths that predate the gate. Every entry names one (path, kind, value) triple and why it is legitimate; a new path in the same file is still reported. Values are written in canonical form (forward slashes, no leading slash) so that this file does not itself contain a string the scanner would match. See scripts/repo-hygiene-lib.mjs for why suppression is per-triple rather than per-file.
